mapper.select: WITH buckets AS ( SELECT generate_series(0, video_time, #{filter.step}::int4) AS bucket_start, LEAST(generate_series(#{filter.step}, video_time + #{filter.step}, #{filter.step}), video_time)::int4 AS bucket_end FROM gc_video WHERE id = #{filter.videoId} ) SELECT ROUND((b.bucket_start + b.bucket_end) / 2.0, 1) as second, count(view_segment.id) as value FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN video_play_session video_session ON video_session.video_id = #{filter.videoId} AND video_session.create_time >= #{filter.start} AND video_session.create_time < #{filter.end} LEFT JOIN video_play_segment view_segment ON view_segment.session_id = video_session.id AND int4range(b.bucket_start, b.bucket_end) && view_segment.segment WHERE b.bucket_start != b.bucket_end GROUP BY b.bucket_start, b.bucket_end ORDER BY b.bucket_start;
